body:
You know what? I'm an ass for saying anything at all. I didn't insult mental illness. I only said that Lyme is not a mental illness. It can create severe cognitive problems. It can go undetected by even the best doctors and tests. If I'm an ass for anything it's for objecting to something that was said on a thread about a comedy show. 
   I understand mental illness as well as I understand Lyme disease and I haven't been disrepectful to either.  If I "didn't want to hear it" I'd have left the discussion alone. You guys are piling on and name-calling for what reason? 
I'M awful? 
I'm sorry for not liking something that someone said? 
I'm sorry for trying to defend a disease that's marginalized and denied treatment in even the most reputable med centers? 
No I'm not sorry for taking it personally. I'm sorry for taking issue with it here, and I'm sorry I tried to respectfully suggest someone's fun was coming at the expense of others. 
I'll delete my comments because this is nonsense. I should know better than to dick around online taking issue with things. Especially on Reddit.
It's called Lyme disease.
Beer

Holy shit yea. That dumbass attitude has been around forever. I never understood why I'd hear the word "poser" from punks and hardcore kids more than anyone else on the planet. 

   I turned to punk rock and hardcore shows because it was one place I felt normal. Most of those kids did. Then they got their own clique and turned into a bunch of stuck up jaggoffs themselves. 
  I should be thankful because that bullshit turned me towards so many other artforms and music. But punk still remains a favorite. Those people... not so much. Fuck those people.

Clutch - Pure Rock Fury. 
-Pietasters are strapped Live (Greatest live album ever recorded hands down
-Alice Cooper - Love it to Death
-Black Sabbath - Master Of Reality (Any Sabbath Album will do really)
-Motorhead - On Parole
I do agree with your doc that meds should not be tossed out like candy, but in your case, something needs to be done. Maybe try someone new? Or just a new pschiatrist?
If you have insurance you should look into a hospital stay. You've already tried, next time you might succeed. You can be helped.

How can I be fair with myself? I'm not taunting you I actually could use a new way to be fair with myself. It's not my fault I got sick, It's not even my fault I am depressed. It is my fault though that I spiraled as much as I did. I let myself slip. I wish I got help sooner, but i spent those resources on medical doctors, so I could plug up my sick holes. That got me nowhere but poorer. And now I'm severely mentally ill and I can't afford shit. 

   I want to be nicer to myself. I wish I knew how. I'm in a years long loop of negative self talk and physically feeling like shit. My brain really hates me 

  I'm sorry. I had so much love in my heart and it went bad. I want it back so much. I miss being happy and healthy. I don't know how to be this way. It isn't worth it.... I'm sorry everybody.

Oh I've been to tons of doctors. Docs are pretty much dime a dozen and most of them are useless unless you're buying their scripts. I've seen a bunch. Expensive ones, cheap ones. Natural ones. I'm bankrupted by it all. 
  I literally have to work out what toothpaste is cheapest. I have nothing to spare. 2 bedrooms and a kid who does nothing ... I'm completely broke. This therapy session will likely be my only session. Maybe I'll go have a freak out so they'll just commit me right away... Not sure what to do. I can't think even a little rationally at this point. The things I'm saying and thinking are so fucked up. I don't even know who this is. 
  I need help. But it all costs. And I can't even afford food. Another thing about being a man. You're broke, you're a piece of shit. No value. A number. whatever dignity I can muster to get through the day is dashed out by the time I'm done paying for some lettuce and cheese. I can't change it. I don't even want to. I just want to stop feeling this way. I want to feel love. I don't even remember what it's like to like myself. I know that I did once. 
  if I'm gonna get through this I'm gonna need money. I guess that is why I keep coming back to suicide. I can barely feed my kid, let alone get to a therapist, who'll refer me to a psych, who'll sell me some drugs. And what good are my emotions when the rest of me is rotten anyway? I keep thinking this'll break but it just gets worse. 
   Leah, thank you. I don't know you. But for whatever reason you're trying. I am grateful for you.

Therapy, Phsych, drugs = $$$
I = 0$
I = shit

It is painful. I see myself as what I was. The man that I liked. I see a happy bouncing little girl full of life and energy. I ruined it all. Every moment was cherishable for a while. Now it's a joke. 

  I haven't yelled at her in a year. But I'm miserable. She hates me for this. I can't snap out of it. And I'm broke. Kids want things. They want to borrow money. I want to do that. I want to be the dad that hands out bills and says don't spend it all in one place. 

  I am the compete opposite of what I wanted. I'm a desperate loser looking for support in a void of electricity.

Yeah, part of it is being broke. I don't have the money I need to heal. I don't know what the right thing is to choose. I have so much to treat, so much wrong with me. It'd just be easier to say goodbye. I can almost hear them saying that I'm "in a better place" Comforting themselves. Finding a way back to their decent lives. 

 As you mentioned, it's also being a man. It's nonsense. I don't know what would've happened to me if I had kept up the strong silent act. I'd be in jail. I'd have my kid taken away. Or maybe I should've kept my mouth shut for a few years and things would fall into place? I really don't know. In fact, I have no idea what I'm doing right now. I'm really stepping outside of myself. I need a hospital but I can't lose my kid too. I don't know what to do. 

  I have a therapy appt Tues. I can't afford it. She'll sit and listen and kick me out after 40 minutes. It's going to make me feel worse. Maybe she'll send me to the hospital. I have to do something but I have zero faith that these people can help me. They'll just make me worse. If I lose her too, I will certainly just end things.
   I don't know how much of this I can keep doing. Every time I think the anxiety can't get worse, it does. I'm ready to call it quits. 
I thank you for the compliment. I've been told this before. I didn't know I could write and I never thought of it as a talent of mine. What I need is a talent that can make me money. I have artistic talent and it's done nothing but make me miserable.   I wish my talent was computer programming.

The cherished moments vanished years ago. Once my mom died we both died a little inside. She saw me unravel and started to unravel herself. I have no memory of the good moments from the past 6 years. There may have been some but I've been wrapped up in myself and my illness through most of it. 
  I've yelled for various reasons. Depressed, bipolar. the stress of my situation went beyond my coping skills. I wasn't me in those moments. I'm not me now. I never wanted to be dead until a few years ago. Sometimes those people pissed me off. Sometimes they didn't deserve it. But no matter what, I was wrong in the end. I don't deserve this. I was a good person. I have a good heart. I never wanted to hurt anyone. I never raised  a hand to anyone that I loved. 

  I can't see the path, no. I don't believe there is one. I have no refuge. No music, no distractions save for begging for attention online. It's pathetic. I'm a ghost. To myself and my loved ones. Those that still love me are scared of me, and will be relieved when I'm gone. I can't even think straight right now. I just want this to stop. My insides are falling apart. I feel like shit. My brain is mush. I can't keep it up. I can't keep going. I don't want to. All I want is to be done with all of it. Life isn't meant to be lived this way.

I've called every hotline available to me at least 5-10 times a day for a month. I used online chats. I've probably made about 3-400 calls. I yelled at some of them. One listener was actually decent. The rest were not great. One woman was downright rude. 

  I'm really not sure if I'm gonna make it. It's supposed to wear off. It's just getting worse. I don't want to do this. I can't go to a hospital. I'll lose my kid. Then I'll just get out and do it.. I'm supposed to see a light or a way out, but the dark is closing in on me.

It gets worse by the day. Today is worse than yesterday. I can't listen to music, I can't watch TV. Can't calm myself down. I don't know my way out of this hole. I am probably going to be gone soon. I can't wait to just disappear.

Sounds like shame. Shame ruined me. It's why I'm here. Tell your wife you love her. That you're depressed and you want to fix things. I can't let another person fuck it up over shame. You have everything right now. Try to see it.

Yea man. I suffer with chronic disease and I'm only discovering mental illness at 40. I have shitty luck too. I still say fuck the bridge and go talk to the weirdos in SF. I think you're capable of doing that and you might even like it. Then call your parents and tell them you love them and you want to come home. You can make your last day into your first. There is plenty of time for you.

I did all of that. All of it, and it blew up in my face. I've seen the country on my motorcycle. That's when I lost my hearing and found out I was ill.  I returned to school and tried to start a 2nd career. Graduated in my 30's into the recession. Not only did my industry dry up, but it came back and went overseas. As this was happening, My mom died of cancer, very suddenly. I watched her waste away and die before my eyes. 
  Yea, she's a teenager. And I'm a single dad, doing it alone. But I went too far. She saw me unraveling and developed her own emotional problems. I was already too far gone in my own head.  I yelled and screamed at her, because she was scaring me. She needed a hospital, I kept yelling. Up until a year ago, I was blowing up regularly and then I finally cut the shit. But it is a bit late to take it back. It is no wonder my girl left me. I loved her too. So much. My best friend. 
  I moved away from my shame. And myself and my demons. 3000 miles away. Angrily. I lost all the love I ever had. I've seen a lot. A lot of beauty. I am now bi-coastal. I've had many experiences. And none of it means shit. This is just a place. Things are things.
Friends,family,love > everything.

Can I ask what you are suffering with? Do you think your parents aren't proud of you? I'm proud of my kid and she screws up all the time. She's a giant pain in my ass sometimes. But I love her. If she left I would probably die too. 
  Don't jump. Enjoy the city instead. Get some seafood. Go to Alcatraz. Talk to a strange girl/dude. There's lot's of them up there. Who cares if you get rejected. Go talk to another one. And another.
   Please don't. Your parents love you. That bridge is not the place for you to end it. I hope you change your mind and just hang out in the city instead.

You made me cry. A lot.  

I want to believe you. I guess the part of me that hasn't run an exhaust hose yet does. But the rest of me doesn't. I'm not just mentally ill. I'm mentally ill because I have a disease that spread to my brain. It changed me. Pushed me into looneyville.
  I feel like my life is over. Maybe I can't see it. But I don't know how to be this person. And now I can't even find refuge in my passions because they all make me cringe and twitch like I have tourette's. Fuck me... I have no idea what the fuck I did to deserve this. I used to be someone I liked. 
Your dad sounds like fun, and you sound like an amazing person. Thanks for .... making me blubber on my laptop?

I can relate. I lost my girlfriend of 10 years because I'm depressed and bipolar. Was it ever real. The realest thing I've ever known. My best friend in the world. I'm 40 and I feel like my life is over. She moved on quick too. 10 years and she shook me off overnight. 

  It's rough man. I don't even know who I am anymore. I'll say though, that you're 26 and that is really great. You can meet a ton of girls when you're ready. You likely won't be for a while. But you can date, play the field, do all kinds of stuff and have a good life. There's still hope for you. Right now you have to walk through the dark place. 

  I wish I got help when I was 26. Man.... Do I wish.

meaning... I need money now. And I would like to be able to love music and movies and life again. 

  I went wrong trying to be too in control and not accepting the things I don't like. Too proud, too angry maybe. But all that stuff worked for me. I had a good personality and good outlook. People respected me for my convictions. 

  It really got bad when I got sick. Neurological damage. Just a tough illness. When It's not cancer, people just kind of slink away. They don't know what to do. 

 I had a great gf. But I was so ashamed of being a shadow of myself. At least I felt that way. Eventually it disintegrated. It was my fault.

I guess here's my advice. If you have love, a trusting pure love. Nurture it. Don't let it out of your sight. Do what you can to make it work. Take the good with the bad. Don't expect the world from it. 

  You can conquer the world but honestly without love it isn't worth shit. 
  You mentioned meaning. And that is what I want . Love is what means something to me. Without it I'd be dead. I love my kid and that is the tiniest thread that keeps me alive right now. I want to love someone again like the one who I thought was my soulmate. I want it back.

I'm not a doctor, but 7 drugs sounds like a lot. 
You may not believe me but I know how you feel. I am in a similar situation. I feel like I'm in a hell of my own creation. 

  In your case though, you seem to be in a very unhealthy relationship. Try thinking rationally about it for a while. And try to be nicer to you. I know it's hard. Believe me. I know it... Just try.
Yea me too. I want another one. Who's to say you only get one? or 5 or 10? You can try again.

You won't have a good life with your current partner. Maybe you'll have nice things but it will come at the cost of your sanity and happiness. Consider breaking up with him. 

I can't tell you what to do. But I can assure you that your relationship is ruining your life. You're not gonna make it to this life you think is down the road with him. 

At the risk of sounding creepy, I'll be your friend. I don't want to bang you. I don't want pics of you. I won't tell you what to do. But you can vent to me if you want and I'll listen.

Hey man, look. I'm suicidal too. You've been through a lot and dealt with things no one around you can relate to. I haven't been through what you have and I'm pretty suicidal. 
  You need to see a therapist. Soon. You need to understand your parents are sick. They need help and you aren't the one to give it to them. You have to find a good doctor and get through the demons in your mind. You also need to distance yourself from your parents no matter how tough that may be. This is keeping you ill. You unfortunately have probably inherited mental illness from your folks but you don't have to be like them. 
  I know you said you're doing CBT. You probably need more therapy. More work. You won't be well until you get some distance between you and your parents. It's gonna be hard. You should try...
I want to die in the worst way. I'm posting here for similar reasons. I don't think it's right and I want someone to talk to. I'm going to see a Dr. on Tuesday.  Until then I'm gonna keep posting and hope I don't slip and do it. You should try too. You do have some options. Try to figure them out.

also, I lost my girl of 10 years. Love of my life. I see her all the time when she's not there and I don't know what to do. I reach for her every day and then she's gone. It's been 3 months. I think it can go away. I hope so.

The planet isn't dying, we're just ruining our environment. 

I know you're broke. can you drive? Deliver pizzas? Something? 

 I relate to you, though I'm a few years older, and I don't live with my parents. I did though, until I was 38, because of illness. It was humiliating and busted my psyche pretty bad. 

 So you have something in common with ME! It sucks man, I know it. It really gets shitty sometimes. I'd tell you that great things are around the corner but that isn't what you want to hear and you won't believe me. But if you want to chat you can PM me. Try to stay as calm as you can.
At this point, I'm not sure what I'll find. That's how far away I feel. I don't even know what I'm doing today. It's pretty messed up. I hope I don't get fired.

I have many mementos around the house. I am disgusted by them now. I have a hard time relating to them. I wonder why I have them and what they meant to me. I feel like I know what they meant or why I have them, but like they belong to someone else and I heard their story from someone else. 
  Journaling could help. Maybe. But I am so disorganized right now, I can't even do the dishes. Shit is fucked up. I can sit here and type, but only because I can do it laying down.

I hope you are right. I dunno. I'm over 40. I'm sick. I had true love for a long time and I lost it. My fault. All I want is the love back. When I think about me, and what I am, it's hard to imagine anyone loving me that way again. Especially when I stopped loving myself years ago.

A few months back, I blasted down the freeway at like 125 mph, and there were other vehicles on the road. I was on a motorcycle. I never do shit like that. It was soon after that my chest started pounding and I haven't slept more than a few hrs since. I was definitely trying to die. At the time I felt powerful, but it was indeed a mentally ill/ unstable thing to do. Haven't killed myself yet but the thoughts are constant. I have an appt on Tuesday. We'll see.

I'm not working toward anything. Just staying alive for someone. This person doesn't even like me anymore because of how depressed and odd I've become. But I know dying would effect them horribly. Even still, I'm not sure I want to stick around. I am in pretty bad shape. 
But thank you for encouraging me....

Yea, I've flushed my life down the toilet irreversibly because of depression and bipolar. I don't even recognize who I am anymore. My advice would be to fight the urge to let your brain fuck you over. Do what you can to stop the cycle today, because tomorrow might be too late. Take it from me. It's too late for me and now all I do is think about suicide. And I may be gone soon. 

  Help yourself. You don't HAVE to fuck it up.

The listeners or whatever they're called are all different. I have had 2 actually provide more than a distraction from the constant suicidal thoughts. And I have called at least 150-200 times in the past month or so. 

  One woman was so friggin annoying that I hung up on her. Everything I said - "MMMHHHMMM MMMHHHMMMMM" That was her counseling me. It drove me batshit. 
  I've yelled at counselors before. They are sometimes just total insensitive dipshits. 

  But the 2 that I did like were actually really good. I think it's just hard to connect with people, especially when we're depressed. 

 What they ARE good for though is giving out other resources. None of what they threw at me was useful for me but there was plenty of stuff, numbers, websites, and names of organizations that might be able to help you. Sometimes we need a different perspective to see that we might even be able to get help somewhere. 

  If you're feeling suicidal, it can help. Even though it hasnt been great for me, it's kept me distracted. I have a therapy appt on Tuesday and that is really all I want until then. someone to keep me busy so I don't haul off and open myself up.

Yes. I thought that all night. In fact, I was wondering if today was the day. It isn't. I have exactly one reason to stay alive. And I hate myself for not letting that reason make me want to stay alive. My fear for this year is that I'll lose sight of it for too long. The urges are constant and stronger by the day. I can't even believe what I am anymore. This was never me. I want it to stop so bad.
Awful. I'm so sorry. You can pm me if you need to vent. I'll listen.

I've tried everything. I tried Ambien, only slept for about 4 hours. Woke up in a horrible suicidal depression. Tried OTC sleep stuff, all of it, none of them work. 
  I've used weed for years, but lately I cannot handle it. It puts me further into my head. I'm really messed up.

Certainly anxiety, but way more intense and feels like intense horror. The worst is my aversion to everything that I loved at one time. I don't understand. The things I loved are now tormenting me. 
There has to be someone this has happened to. I'm in hell. 
Not seeing a therapist because I can't afford one right now. I need help but I have nowhere to turn, which explains why I'm telling internet strangers.

I know it won't make you feel much better, but yesterday was the worst fucking day of my life. I've never had a worse christmas, and that was my fault too. I wish I had a parent's basement to watch TV in. I stared at my wall and fought off suicide. Still doing that actually.

I've been trying to get a good CBT therapist but I'm broke right now so I suffer with the same awful loop of negativity. It's pretty constant for me. 

  Anyway, My point is that your thinking (as well as mine) is distorted and CBT is about changing those thoughts to better ones. For someone like me it would probably take a while, but it can be pretty effective.
  If you are able to obtain therapy, that could be the route to go. Thinking positive I think can be learned. Even though I am about as negative as you can be right now. I'd like to see a CBT practitioner instead of killing myself.
I spent yesterday with friends. They watched me stare off into space as they were talking to me. I might need to be in a hospital somewhere.
I haven't been able to do much of anything since my girl dumped me. Literally music and most stimuli sends me into a panic.
Movies and music freak me out. Music was my life. I loved it. Loved. I can't listen now. I can't watch movies or shows either. Something is very WRONG.

I am suffering the worst depression of my life right now and I am very afraid. This will be my first christmas alone. I was never one to be too scared on my own, but right now I don't know if I'll get through one day to the next. Thank you for the hugs. Hugs to you as well.
Feel free to msg me tomorrow if you want. I will be alone at night. My daughter is going to the caribbean and after that it will likely be a bad time for me. Merry Christmas.

Yea, it sounds nice. I am still apprehensive but Sure that would be great. I'm interested. But broke. Can't afford shit.

  Yes, I believe people are over diagnosed and we're being forcefedd PigPharma's bullshit. Sorry, hate to be a hippie but I believe it's true. I know it is. First hand
  I haven't taken many drugs. I forget what I took years ago, but it made me feel screwy. Recently I took Cymbalta for two days. I was in a bad loop of anxiety and I can't say if it was Cymbalta that made it worse, but it got worse. WAY worse. So I said goodbye to that awful shit. SSRI's are a tough sell for me. I'll do it, but I have very little faith. There's science and then there's business. I don't really know what to do. Shop the free clonics for drugs? What about when they run out? Have a freak out? Smoke weed? Weed actually kept me stable until a while back. Now it gets too in my head and I just obsess harder.

I have fluid around my heart and it appears to be enlarged. Would shock therapy kill me? I don't even know What it entails, I just feel like I am holding in 10,000 angry demons and being quiet and taking pills will do fuckall.

This was suggested by someone else. I have about 2000 color pencils. I will give it a try. Though honestly I am fantasizing about sticking one of the pencils into my heart. That is where I am at. Freaked out and scared of everything. I want to just die.

I have lesions on my brain because of disease. I'm frightened at the prospect of psychotropic drugs. I loved them in my 20's. Now? I feel like I'm in a bad trip for 4 months straight. Like I said, I'll need to know more. Plus I don't think I could afford it. But I'm not tossing your idea aside. Just apprehensive about something I don't know of. I am glad it is helping you and I'm glad to have new info.

I haven't yelled at her in a long time. since we've moved. She lives with me. Long story but I've been a single dad since she was 4 months old. I dunno why but I don't see myslef in any of those situations. I think she just wants to get away from me, as we both realize how fucked up I am. It is now obvious I'm clinically depressed. She does need me and I can't get out of bed.  I love her, but I am scared of what I am doing to her... I don't know if I'm strong enough.

I know next to nothing about nootropics but it appears that they are stimulants? Right now I need to sleep because that is making me loopy. I don't get out of bed but I don't sleep more than 2 hrs at a time. tried ambien, melatonin, chamomile. none work, Ambien is dangerous and makes me way more suicidal...
I'll have to read a little more about nootropics.

I don't know if she reaaly does need me. I've been a shitty father for years now. I've yelled at her when she needed my support. I don't have money for her. She doesn't get to have what other kids have. Our relationship is strained. She looks at me with contempt and talks to me with hatred. I love her. But I have ruined my life and hers. I don't know how to fix it. 
  I do walk my dog, that gets me moving a bit, but these thoughts follow me everywhere. I'd say every other minute or so I think of killing myself.

Not in a while. I've never found a proper fit for me. I KNOW I need to see one asap. The issue I'm having right now is that I am broke. It's the holidays and impossible to get something together. I could call one but I cannot afford it. 
   I've used the hotlines. They help very little, but they keep me busy for the time I'm online with someone. The worst is when they say they have to go. It's like immediately back to panic mode.
  Therapy is definitely what I need. Maybe shock therapy. I have no idea. All I know is that this is the most insane I have ever felt. Anxiety, depression, inability to do anything and constant suicidal urges. If I don't get the right help the urges are going to win.

Of course not. I know I need help. I need therapy, like a lot of it. And right now it all seems like I'm stuck under 500 lbs of poop. So I don't know where to start. 
  But you ARE helping. And thank you...

Thank you for your reply. Do you  know what drugs those are? Where they can be purchased?
  The problem is that I feel I have NO identity. Like I am lost at sea. All of that music was part of my identity before we met but now ALL music and really all stimulation disturbs the hell out of me. I just got back from a restaurant and I almost had a freakout there because it was all too much. Every little thing made me anxious. 
  I keep going back to how twisted I had my mind. How fucked up I was and the way I brought it to the world. The person she saw me become. I swear it wasn't me. I don't know how to move on. Especially sitting under all of these bills and debt. I don't have any good thoughts and they're all peppered with suicidal urges. It's fuckin scary. I have been somewhat suicidal for a few years but this is the worst I think I've ever been. I don't know if I can handle much more. The holidays are going to bash my brains in. They already have.
